about:
# WoW Forever addons

Addons for WoW Forever (client 1.60.1, interface 16001). Download the zips from
[Releases](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/releases).

| Addon | What it does | Guide |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Keel](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/AddonProjects/forever/Keel) | The shared kit the others build on: Forever theme, widgets, sliders, lists, gallery (`/keel`) | [Docs/Keel.md](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/Docs/Keel.md) |
| [Stickies](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/AddonProjects/forever/Stickies) | Notes on the screen, with a minimap and Addon Compartment entry | [Docs/Stickies.md](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/Docs/Stickies.md) |
| [RenderTuner](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/AddonProjects/forever/RenderTuner) | A live control for about 160 graphics settings, upscaling and quality presets, search, Auto-set and undo (`/tuner`) | [Docs/RenderTuner.md](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/Docs/RenderTuner.md) |

## Install

Extract the zips into `_forever_\Interface\AddOns` so you get
`AddOns\Keel\Keel.toc` and so on, then restart the client. Keel is required by the others.

## Working on it

```powershell
python scripts/lint.py
.\scripts\run-tests.ps1 -Flavor forever -Addon RenderTuner   # needs LuaJIT
.\scripts\deploy.ps1 -Flavor forever -Addon RenderTuner      # links it into the game folder
```

[CODING_STANDARDS.md](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/CODING_STANDARDS.md) and [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/terin678/wow-forever-addons/blob/main/CLAUDE.md) cover conventions.

releases.name: RenderTuner 0.7.1
releases.notes:
RenderTuner 0.7.1

Nothing in RenderTuner's settings or panel changes; this release is about how it is delivered.

- On CurseForge, Keel is no longer inside RenderTuner's download. Keel is a project of its own there, and the app installs it with RenderTuner.
- On Wago and GitHub the download still carries Keel, as before.
- RenderTuner says so at login if the Keel it finds is older than it needs.
- If the game reports a missing dependency after updating, install or reinstall Keel from CurseForge.

releases.name: Keel 1.0.0
releases.notes:
Keel 1.0.0

Keel's first release as a project of its own. Until now it came only inside RenderTuner's download.

- The libraries are the same as in 0.14.0 and the 0.15.0 beta; only how Keel is delivered has changed.
- If you already have Keel from RenderTuner, this replaces the same folder; your settings are kept.
- If RenderTuner or Stickies reports a missing dependency, install or reinstall Keel.

releases.name: RenderTuner 0.7.0
releases.notes:
RenderTuner 0.7.0

- Goggles: a few settings changed together for a while and put back with one click. Snow goggles are the first pair, for a blizzard or a white-out. They lower Brightness and raise Contrast a little from where you have them, switch off Bloom and the Full-screen glow, and thin the snowfall. Taking them off puts each setting back as it was. A setting you move yourself while they are on is left where you put it.
- An icon on the screen. Click it and the goggles spiral out around it. Click a pair to put it on or take it off, and click the icon again to put them away. Right-click it for a menu and drag it anywhere. /tuner hud hides it or brings it back.
- The goggles are also in the Addon Compartment's right-click menu, and /tuner goggles lists them or puts a pair on.
- The panel says which pair is on. Keep records your settings without the goggles.

releases.name: RenderTuner 0.6.1
releases.notes:
RenderTuner 0.6.1

- The shared library that ships inside RenderTuner is now called Keel. It was ICKit. Once you have updated, the old ICKit folder in AddOns can be deleted.
- RenderTuner sits under Graphics in the AddOns list, and Keel under Libraries.
- If you had picked a theme with /ickit theme, pick it again with /keel theme. The Impulse Control theme is now called Navy and no longer carries a logo.
- No settings or saved values change.

releases.name: RenderTuner 0.6.0
releases.notes:
RenderTuner 0.6.0

- Twenty-four more settings, after the client's whole list of console variables was read again. Among them: ground clutter density and distance (well past the top of the game's own slider), the screenshot format (JPEG, PNG or TGA), a frame rate limit for loading screens, refraction, shading rates for the world and for particles, and character texture compression, highlights and glow.
- Extreme now takes ground clutter to the client's ceiling. If you were already on Extreme, click it once more to take the new values; a lower level still puts back what you had before.
- Lighting quality has a fourth level, which the game's own top quality level uses.
- Fixed: Particle density offered a sixth level the client does not have.
- Fixed: Light distance offered 4096, which the client never kept. It now stops at 2048.
